2007.title: Founding of VIEGRID
2007.content: In 2007, VIEGRID was established, marking the beginning of a pioneering journey in information technology and digital transformation in Vietnam. This was the predecessor of PalmTek Innovation JSC, laying the foundation for the innovative and effective solutions the company would pursue in the future.

2008.title: Innovation in Translation with VIEGRID
content: Provided telecommunications security monitoring software to a company in Singapore.
Developed the BOCOHAN V-LANG English–Vietnamese translation solution.

2009.title: Remote Working System Project
2009.content: Implemented a secure remote working system for the Quang Ninh Provincial People’s Committee. This project laid the groundwork for concepts in cybersecurity and the development of the V-AZUR platform.

2010.title: Solution Releases
content: - Further developed the BOCOHAN/V-LANG translation solution with a Chinese version.
- Supplied BOCOHAN/V-LANG for the World Bank’s translation project..
- Provided BOCOHAN/V-LANG to the Vietnam News Agency and VTC Digital Television to support translation and broadcasting.
- Completed R&D phase of the V-AZUR cybersecurity solution.

2012.title: Testing of V-AZUR
content: The Department of High-Tech Crime Prevention and Control (C50) has tested the V-AZUR product according to the cooperation categories between C50, the Institute of Information Technology - VNU, and VIEGRID.
C50 has assessed the level of cybersecurity for the solution according to Official Dispatch No. 1675/C50-P1.

2013.title: V-AZUR Deployment to Partners
content: Supplied V-AZUR to the IT Department of the Ministry of Finance; Information Center of the Ministry of Construction; National Archives; IT Department of the State Bank of Vietnam; and the Department of Science and Technology of the Ministry of Industry and Trade.

Provided enterprise software for the Departments of Information and Communications of Hanoi, Thua Thien Hue, and Ho Chi Minh City; the Quang Ninh People’s Committee Office; as well as the Ministry of Industry and Trade, Ministry of Finance, and Ministry of Construction.

2015.title: Sao Khue Award Recognition
2015.content: In 2015, VIEGRID owas honored with the Sao Khue Award for its V-AZUR solution, affirming its position in the field of cybersecurity. The product was highly recognized for its innovation and effectiveness, contributing to enhancing information security for both enterprises and government agencies.

2019.title: Cybersecurity Business License
2019.content: VIEGRID was officially licensed to provide cybersecurity products and services under the 2015 Cybersecurity Law, confirming its qualifications to deliver trusted security solutions and strengthening its credibility in Vietnam’s information security sector.

2020.title: Development of V-TRANSFORM
2020.content: VVIEGRID collaborated to develop the V-TRANSFORM digital transformation solution suite for ministries, agencies, and government organizations.

2023.title: V-LAKE Data Platform
2023.content: VIEGRID successfully researched, developed, and deployed the V-LAKE Data Platform – a modern data lake solution enabling integration of raw, semi-structured, and structured data from diverse sources. The platform supports real-time analytics, AI/ML applications, and complies with national security standards, enhancing digital transformation efficiency for Vietnamese organizations and enterprises.

2025.title: PalmTek - A New Chapter
2025.content: In 2025, VIEGRID officially rebranded as PalmTek, marking a new phase of development focused on expanding digital technology and cybersecurity solutions. This transformation reflects a strategic brand repositioning and aims to enhance international competitiveness while continuing to support digital transformation for both government bodies and enterprises in Vietnam.
